scope: Bounded source semantics and gross anatomical plausibility of the twelve selected SPL labels. This is not expert clinical segmentation validation, a whole-module audit, or deployment approval.
method: Read primary publisher description and archived original MRML, lookup table and label metadata.
Independently decoded native source arrays, verified original NRRD reconstruction identities, and computed label components/physical coordinates without the product coordinate code.
Visually inspected native T1 and T2 axial/coronal/sagittal panels for each of twelve labels; selected planes only, not every-slice expert boundary review.
Inspected native T1 panels through both isolated left-fornix components and actual viewer screenshots for both surface representations.
Compared source contribution with current epilepsy, dementia and brain-anatomy reporting requirements.
Inspected three focused screenshots captured after the ordinary outlier control in the authenticated mobile reader: source disclosure, actual MRI and probe readout.

identity_and_laterality.caution: RAS x=0 is not an independently fitted anatomical midline; a few near-midline cells crossing it do not alone establish a side error.

anatomical_observation.gross_location: Plausible in the inspected original planes for all twelve selected source objects.

findings.finding: The known isolated left-fornix source cell was not specifically disclosed by the original generic components/discrepancy wording.
findings.correction: Selected left-fornix note now states the retained isolated cell, unvalidated continuity and finite sampled 12.24 mm comparison; ordinary Inspect retained fornix outlier control selects its native MRI/readout. Right-fornix note identifies the 7.17 mm vertex discrepancy.
findings.remaining_uncertainty: No repaired or deleted data; biological meaning of the isolated cell and the preferable anatomical representation remain unresolved. Finite face-centre/vertex distances are not continuous Hausdorff bounds.

findings.finding: Exact cell boundaries and original processed surfaces encode different representations, most visibly at the fornices.
findings.disposition: Default cell boundaries honestly display the categorical labels, with separately named original-surface comparison. Neither representation is established as biological ground truth.

findings.finding: Twelve labels from one source case contribute gross limbic context but cannot complete the three reporting modules.
findings.disposition: Seventeen explicit requirement dispositions retain missing disease/sequence/structure/normality evidence. Other Primer sources are outside this package-specific gap claim.

findings.finding: After selecting the remote outlier, the selected-source paragraph still says the selected slice passes near the source label centroid. This is also potentially false after manual slice changes.
findings.proposed_correction: Describe the Find structure in MRI action as selecting a label sample near its centroid; do not describe every current slice this way.
findings.correction: Source paragraph now says: Find structure in MRI selects an original label sample near its centroid; this is not a normative volume measurement.
findings.disposition: The action description remains true after outlier selection or manual slice navigation; data/geometry unchanged.

disposition.useful_as: Partial source-defined anatomy reference with explicit uncertainties
disposition.release_decision: Outside this semantic review; transport, access, final UI and integration verification are separate.
